api.label: Service list
api.description: A table of departures, one service per row, scrolling page by page when the rows do not fit.

prop.name: font
prop.help: Font used to render table cells.

prop.name: max_cols
prop.help: Maximum columns per row. Determines allocated RAM.

prop.name: scroll_dwell_ms
prop.help: Time in ms to hold each page before scrolling.

prop.name: scroll_duration_ms
prop.help: Duration of page scroll animation in ms.
